প্রদত্ত বাক্যটি Present Perfect Tense-এর negative interrogative sentence:

Present Perfect Tense-এর negative interrogative sentence-কে passive করার গঠন:

Has/Have + object [Active voice-এর object the picture passive voice-এর subject হয়েছে] + not + been + verb-এর past participle + by + subject?

Has + he + not + seen + the picture?
→ Has + the picture + not + been + seen + by him?

------
